adaptations: tensor_parallel_size 4 -> 1, explicitly documented by the author README for single-GPU machines
vLLM swap_space=0, host-specific compatibility adaptation required by the current pinned-memory limit; model weights and generation sampling parameters remain unchanged

P1b logprob physical microbatch=1: after larger physical batches OOMed before candidate generation, execute the same released per-example logprob operation one example at a time and concatenate in original order; this is the minimal possible physical batch and no transition is dropped or altered

P1b vllm_gpu_utilization 0.75 -> 0.55: reduce KV-cache preallocation to leave temporary workspace for prompt-logprob rank tensors; evidence, weights, sampling parameters, and PPO math remain unchanged

stochastic_repeats.rule: A_canonical and D_pre_gate_quotient use separate fresh processes with the same harness seed within each pair. The released LocalLLM does not expose a sampling seed; its vLLM engine default seed remains 0 in every fresh process.

identity_arms.A_canonical: All six frozen Experience.skill fields point to HypothesisElimination.
identity_arms.B_id_placebo: All six point to one exact-semantic renamed parent HypothesisElimination_Renamed.
identity_arms.C_exact_split: Episodes 1-3 point to HypothesisElimination_A and episodes 4-6 to exact-semantic HypothesisElimination_B; neither buffer reaches six.
identity_arms.D_pre_gate_quotient: The conceptual 3+3 class is reunited before the author scheduler: one canonical HypothesisElimination parent receives all six evidence records before readiness evaluation.
identity_arms.E_late_identity_dedup: The 3+3 scheduler call occurs first; after the missed gate one alias is removed without merging its experience buffer, followed by a second empty-evidence scheduler call to test whether the missed opportunity is restored.

pool_state_contract.seed_pool: All six pinned first-party seed Skill semantics are materialized without retrieval-embedding initialization because retrieval is outside P1b evolution and the released encoder path is an author-machine absolute path.
pool_state_contract.focal_stats: Reconstruct the stats that author run_episodes_in_env would have produced from the six frozen P1a records before evolution: canonical total frequency=15, total_gain=2.5, avg_gain=1/6, success_count=6, maturity=1. Split arms partition these statistics by the same 3+3 episode attribution.
pool_state_contract.candidate_add: Use the pinned author's SkillEvolution scheduler unchanged; the harness pool add_skill appends the returned candidate but intentionally skips retrieval embedding cache population because retrieval is not invoked in P1b.

P2_reopen_condition: Only if A and D reach real candidate/PPO hooks, C reaches neither, semantic evidence remains identical across arms, and a real resulting-pool difference exists that is suitable for held-out replay.
